title: What If You Stood on Saturn's Moon Titan?

scenes.text: What if you stood on Titan? The air is thick enough that you could almost fly.
It's minus 179 degrees Celsius, about minus 290 Fahrenheit, and that never really changes.
The air pressure is 1.5 times Earth's, so no suit needs to fight a vacuum, but the air is mostly nitrogen.
Gravity is under 14 percent of Earth's. A 70 kilogram person would weigh about 10.
Sunlight is only about 1 percent of Earth's, like twilight ten minutes after sunset.
Thick air and weak gravity make flight easier there than on Earth. NASA is sending a drone, Dragonfly, in 2028.

description:
What if you stood on Titan, Saturn's largest moon?
Its air is 1.5 times thicker than ours and its gravity is under 14 percent of Earth's, which is why NASA is sending a flying drone.
